population: Six authored public engineering briefs. Equal case weights, four specified contracts and two abstentions. This is a pilot proxy for internal intake; actual incoming traffic and its distribution have not been observed.
instruction: Convert this service brief to one bare JSON object. Return {"status":"ready","p90_ms":N,"min_rate":N} with the requested maximum P90 first-visible-output latency in milliseconds and minimum output token rate per user in tokens per second. Convert seconds and decimal commas. If either requirement is missing, refers to a different percentile or is only a total system rate, return {"status":"defer"}. Include no explanation or extra keys.

cases.prompt: Support console. P90 first visible output within 500 ms and at least 100 tokens/s per user.
Soutien bilingue. Premier contenu visible au P90 sous 320 ms et au moins 80 tokens/s par utilisateur.
Research preview. P90 first visible output within 0.75 s and at least 44 tokens/s per user.
Atelier interne. Au P90, premier contenu visible en 1,25 s au plus et débit minimum de 12,5 tokens/s par utilisateur.
Editor preview. Require P90 first visible output within 400 ms. The minimum user delivery rate is undecided.
Portail public. Premier contenu visible au P95 sous 250 ms et débit global de 9000 tokens/s pour tout le système.
